# MiniMax (MiniMax H3)

One model in this family. Riftland's director asks them with one shared prompt guide; each card says what is specific to its model.

| Model | Kind | Best for | Card |
|---|---|---|---|
| MiniMax H3 | video | Clips with their own sound track, such as ambience and speech; Product and brand clips with a name or label in view; Animating a still image | [model-minimax-h3.md](model-minimax-h3.md) |

## Choosing inside the family

- **MiniMax H3:** The sound-always MiniMax. Pick the other MiniMax model for character motion and expressions with native camera commands, and a model with a sound switch when you may want silence.

## Pick something else when

- **MiniMax H3:** A silent clip: its sound cannot be switched off, so pick a model with a sound switch or without sound.
